{{Quote|When I was a kid, I liked to make up stories about Captain Ræh—about who she was and what planet she might have come from.|Rey|<ref name="Survival Guide" />}}
'''Dosmit Ræh''' was a [[Gender|female]] [[starfighter]] [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] who served as a [[captain]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. She flew an [[T-65B X-wing starfighter|X-wing starfighter]] and led the [[Tierfon Yellow Aces]].

==Biography==
Dosmit Ræh was a [[Gender|female]] individual who served as a [[captain]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]], a rebel group that opposed the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine's]] [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TFA VD" /> At some point, she led the [[Tierfon Yellow Aces]],<ref name="Saga of Rey">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Saga of Rey}}</ref> a rebel [[starfighter]] [[squadron]] and [[Rebel pilot|piloted]] a [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]].<ref name="TFA VD" />

[[File:Rey_AT-AT.png|thumb|right|260px|Rey kept Dosmit Ræh's memory alive.]]
[[Standard year|Years]] after the [[Galactic Civil War]], Ræh's [[flight helmet]] was recovered by a young [[desert]] [[scavenger]] on [[Jakku]] named [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]]. When Rey was a girl, Ræh became an important figure in Rey's life, with the young scavenger [[dream]]ing up stories about what Ræh was like and where she might have come from. Rey created a [[Alliance pilot doll|fighter pilot]] [[doll]] using a [[flight suit]] she recovered from a [[cargo container]], and she often wore Ræh's flight [[helmet]]. Together, Rey and "Ræh" went on adventures by exploring Rey's home, the downed [[All Terrain Armored Transport]] called ''[[Hellhound Two]]'', as well as the sands outside of the [[All Terrain Armored Transport (Galactic Civil War)|AT-AT]]. Rey eventually grew out of playing with the doll, but she kept the memory of Ræh alive by keeping the doll and her helmet in her possession throughout her years on Jakku.<ref name="Survival Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:DosmitRaehHelmet-Wired.png|thumb|right|250px|Dosmit Ræh's helmet]]
Although Ræh herself did not make an appearance in [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], her flight helmet did.<ref name="Episode VII">{{Film|VII}}</ref>
